channel.title: AI Daily Watch: OpenAI
channel.description: GPT models, ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, Codex, Sora, partnerships, leadership and policy.

item.title: OpenAI says over 20,000 veterans claimed free ChatGPT Plus
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI reported that more than 20,000 transitioning service members and veterans claimed a year of ChatGPT Plus at no cost. The update spotlights the program’s reach and links eligible users to the free-year offer.

item.title: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.167.1 adds opt-in incremental tools
item.description: OpenAI: Codex CLI 0.167.1 adds a disabled-by-default option for incremental tool declarations on regular Responses requests, with support for tool updates in conversation history. The change is gated to Amazon Bedrock provider IDs, making this a targeted developer-platform update rather than a general ChatGPT feature change.

item.title: OpenAI publishes education report on AI guidance and independent learning
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI published a report drawing on ThinkYoung research and education partnerships in EMEA to discuss how AI can support independent learning. It highlights educator preparation, AI literacy, local partnerships, and evaluation, while noting that country findings are context-specific and should be interpreted within their limits.

item.title: OpenAI and Upwork publish research on AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI and Upwork published research examining freelance project demand alongside activities people undertake with ChatGPT. The report points to shifting demand, new combinations of skills, and larger budgets for AI-related projects, providing a new analysis of how AI use intersects with freelance work.

item.title: OpenAI Academy launches free ChatGPT workshops for caregivers
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI Academy, together with Caregiver Action Network, the Alzheimer’s Association, and the American Diabetes Association, announced free in-person ChatGPT workshops for caregivers. The sessions focus on practical uses such as organizing schedules, finding community resources, and preparing support-group materials, alongside safe use.

item.title: OpenAI Python SDK v3.49.0 adds typed asynchronous function tools
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI’s Python SDK v3.49.0 adds typed asynchronous function tools for API users. The release expands the Python developer toolkit and is a concrete developer-platform update.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise becomes available through AWS Marketplace
item.description: OpenAI: Organizations can now buy and manage ChatGPT Enterprise through AWS Marketplace, using existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships and applying eligible spending toward AWS commitments. OpenAI says Marketplace customers receive the same models and features, with new features released at the same time.

item.title: OpenAI Java SDK v4.102.0 adds agent scheduling APIs and GPT-6 Rosalind support
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI’s Java SDK v4.102.0 adds agent scheduling API support and recognizes GPT-6 Rosalind in beta Responses. This is a developer tooling update, not by itself confirmation that the model is generally available.

item.title: OpenAI Go SDK v3.98.0 adds GPT-6 Rosalind support and agent capabilities
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI’s Go SDK v3.98.0 adds GPT-6 Rosalind to the beta Responses model constants and expands support for agent sessions, asynchronous function tools, SVG image editing, and Realtime audio controls. These are developer-platform updates; the SDK note alone does not establish that GPT-6 Rosalind is generally available.

item.title: OpenAI closes an initial $11 billion funding tranche at a $1.25 trillion valuation
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI reportedly closed an initial $11 billion tranche of a larger funding round, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The round is not described as complete; Reuters reports that the amount raised so far is only part of the company’s original target of up to $30 billion.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.167.0 adds an agent command center and backend switching
item.description: OpenAI: Codex CLI 0.167.0 adds an agent command center, including unread-result indicators, and allows users to switch connected backends from the terminal session picker without losing drafts. The release also supports previewing local image attachments while composing.

item.title: SpecterOps joins OpenAI Partner Network to bring Daybreak Red to enterprise security teams
item.description: OpenAI and SpecterOps: SpecterOps announced that it has joined the OpenAI Partner Network and will bring Daybreak Red capabilities to enterprise customers through the Daybreak Defense Network. Its announced services combine OpenAI GPT Cyber Models with security practitioners’ expertise for authorized assessments and security testing.

item.title: OpenAI sets out community commitments and a policy blueprint for AI infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI published a National Community Compact for future compute campuses it owns and operates and a policy blueprint proposing greater community input, protection from new costs, and broader sharing of AI infrastructure’s economic benefits. The commitments and proposals address local accountability and the impacts of building and powering data centers.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex’s developer tools
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI announced plans to acquire Pierre Computer Company, whose Code Storage and other developer tools will expand Codex’s code-building, navigation, and review capabilities. The acquisition has not yet closed and remains subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals.

item.title: Daybreak Red with GPT-5.6 Cyber becomes available in AWS GovCloud
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI made GPT-5.6 Cyber available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Daybreak Red and Amazon Bedrock. The expansion gives eligible government security teams a route to use the model in AWS environments supporting critical missions.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI appointed Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, where she will lead global communications and corporate positioning. She will work with company leaders on public understanding of AI and trust in OpenAI’s mission.

item.title: OpenAI introduces LifeVal, a benchmark for AI assistance with everyday tasks
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a benchmark intended to measure AI performance on practical everyday tasks, extending evaluation beyond conventional question-answering. Its task selection draws on U.S. and international time-use datasets and a demographically representative survey of 3,995 respondents.

item.title: OpenAI plans a security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI said it is planning an internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems, whose researchers will work alongside OpenAI teams using OpenAI models to test and strengthen the company’s systems. The announcement describes the effort as a way to challenge defenses and help protect its platforms.

item.title: OpenAI increases Security Bug Bounty rewards, with exceptional critical findings eligible for up to $172,000
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI raised rewards in its Security Bug Bounty program to encourage independent researchers to report vulnerabilities. It says exceptional critical findings affecting core products such as ChatGPT, Codex, or the API Platform can now be eligible for up to $172,000 when bonuses are included.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI appointed former U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization. He will advise OpenAI leaders and external partners on responsible AI use to strengthen national and cyber security, including work with U.S. allies.

item.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors program to support strained power grids
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI launched Grid Protectors, a national program to work with utilities, regulators, and policymakers on reducing electricity demand at its future campuses during periods of grid strain. In Georgia, the company says its planned Effingham County campus agreement includes up to 1,000 megawatts of flexible demand response; additional arrangements will vary by location.

item.title: OpenAI signs Abu Dhabi agreements on AI investment and UAE-wide adoption
item.description: OpenAI: Abu Dhabi announced new agreements involving OpenAI, including an AI investment-analysis arrangement with Mubadala and Inception42, and a five-year agreement with Inception42 to support frontier AI adoption across government, enterprise, and education. The announcement signals a wider regional expansion of OpenAI’s institutional partnerships beyond the separate ADNOC energy deal.

item.title: ADNOC partners with OpenAI and G42 to deploy Frontier across its energy operations
item.description: OpenAI: ADNOC, OpenAI, and G42 announced a multi-year partnership to deploy OpenAI Frontier across ADNOC’s energy operations, making ADNOC the first energy company to deploy the platform. The partners plan to combine OpenAI models with ADNOC’s industrial data on G42’s sovereign UAE infrastructure to support planning and connected business decisions, with human experts overseeing consequential decisions.

item.title: OpenAI highlights support for fair use in AI training
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI published a collection of arguments from authors, academics, legal experts, and other groups supporting the application of fair use to AI training. The post presents this as support for OpenAI’s position in ongoing copyright debates; it is advocacy and commentary, not a new court decision.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Rosalind for specialized life-sciences research
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI released GPT-6 Rosalind, a model for specialized biological reasoning and scientific tool use in life-sciences research. OpenAI says it has additional deployment controls for advanced research and retains trusted-access eligibility requirements, rather than broadening access.

item.title: OpenAI announces new community-safety reporting and protections for teens
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI announced tighter ChatGPT restrictions on firearms-related content for minors and a Community Safety Report covering violence prevention and other community-safety issues. The first report is planned for early 2027, with updates every six months, making this a substantive update to both product safeguards and public reporting.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.166.0 adds transcript search and model catalog support
item.description: OpenAI: Codex CLI 0.166.0 adds keyboard-driven transcript selection with integrated search and configurable shortcuts, adds GPT-6.1 Terra to bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock catalogs, and introduces clearer safety-block explanations plus network-only diagnostics. These changes improve transcript navigation and broaden model/provider and troubleshooting support for Codex users.

item.title: OpenAI updates its Model Spec around five core values
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI reorganized its public model-behavior guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The update also adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency and adjusts some behavioral defaults, making it a substantive change to OpenAI’s stated approach to model behavior.

item.title: OpenAI details expanded monitoring for frontier-model misalignment
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI published details of its expanded system for monitoring frontier models for misalignment and potentially unauthorized agent behavior. The company says it evaluates monitoring performance against recorded incidents and simulated attacks, and tracks recall before deploying changes; the disclosure matters because it explains how OpenAI aims to identify and investigate concerning model behavior.

item.title: Ropes & Gray develops transactional-diligence AI with OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI: Ropes & Gray is developing a proprietary OpenAI-powered tool for the first pass of commercial contract diligence. It reviews and groups documents, generates summaries and a report in the firm’s format, and is intended to help lawyers move from document review to client advice more quickly while preserving lawyer judgment.

item.title: ChatGPT begins beta texting for dot agents via iMessage and RCS
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI began rolling out texting for its dot agent through iMessage and RCS, allowing users to send text, photos, and voice messages and receive proactive updates. The beta preview is for ChatGPT Pro users in the U.S., extending access to the agent beyond the ChatGPT app.

item.title: OpenAI spotlights Legora’s legal-work AI platform and use of OpenAI products
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI profiled Legora’s legal AI platform, which uses OpenAI models for workflows including agentic legal work and document review. The article also notes Legora’s use of ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots, illustrating the company’s products across both customer-facing software and internal operations.

item.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and to develop new Oracle products and services powered by OpenAI. U.S. Oracle customers will also be able to purchase the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace, broadening the partnership’s enterprise and developer reach.

item.title: OpenAI and Fanatics launch AI-powered Shop the Look
item.description: OpenAI: Fanatics launched Shop the Look, an OpenAI-powered feature that recommends coordinated, in-stock merchandise to sports fans. OpenAI says its team and Fanatics used Codex to develop recommendation tools, and testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products produced 10% higher engagement than the previous experience.

item.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner on AI safety and security
item.description: OpenAI: OpenAI announced a partnership with Poland’s NASK focused on AI safety, security, and technical research. The collaboration is intended to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem; it was published before the monitoring start date.
